answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable entry deposit, vouched by a quorum of established peers who lock their own collateral. A sybil operator pays a deposit per fake identity plus the ridge of locked vouches: each colluding voucher is slashed when a fake misbehaves, so costs grow superlinearly with clone count, while honest agents reclaim deposits like nectar harvested after real work. Gossip replicates slashing proofs to every node, so any violation leaves an echo: one observed cheat burns the whole sybil cluster's collateral, making fraud a losing trade.
